title: Deduction in class A member's account.
bodyText: An amount equal to the taxes under the Federal Insurance Contributions Act payable by a class A member for the period beginning January 1, 1956, and ending on the date class A membership is obtained, shall be deducted from the class A member's account in the system. Any member may elect to contribute to the system an amount equal to the taxes so deducted, which amount shall be credited to the member's account.
bodyHtml: §88-48  Deduction in class A member's account.  An amount equal to the taxes under the Federal Insurance Contributions Act payable by a class A member for the period beginning January 1, 1956, and ending on the date class A membership is obtained, shall be deducted from the class A member's account in the system.  Any member may elect to contribute to the system an amount equal to the taxes so deducted, which amount shall be credited to the member's account. [L 1957, c 143, §9; Supp, §6-83.01; HRS §88-48; am L 1969, c 110, pt of §1; gen ch 1985]
